pipeline.title: 1. Entity x behavior matrix
pipeline.text: 26,074 entities, one row each; columns are behavior categories; cells are total activity.

pipeline.title: 2. Sample
pipeline.text: 300 entities analysed (seed 42); the rest of the data is not scored.

pipeline.title: 3. Similarity graph
pipeline.text: Min-max scale, cosine similarity, keep pairs with similarity >= 0.85: 2,544 edges. Entities with no edge are dropped.

pipeline.title: 4. Communities
pipeline.text: Louvain groups entities that are densely connected to each other.

pipeline.title: 5. Tiers
pipeline.text: Communities are ranked by average total activity and split into 3 tiers (equal number of communities per tier). Every entity inherits its community's tier.

diagnostics.text: 4 community(ies) have 2 or fewer members. Tiny groups can skew tiers; consider raising 'min community size'.
2 tiny community(ies) (<=2 members) landed in the 'High Engagement' tier. Tiers are formed from communities, not entities, so a 2-person group counts as much as a 40-person one.

Similarity uses cosine on min-max scaled values, so it compares the SHAPE of behavior (what people do), while tiers use the MAGNITUDE (how much they do). A community can be 'similar' yet differ in volume.
NMI vs. the label is low (0.05). Communities group entities by behavior pattern, which need not coincide with the label (e.g. final result).
